integrity_note: The full universal result combines a direct geometric fundamental-group proof with a cited primary all-field homology theorem, universal coefficients, and the homology Whitehead theorem. Finite exact computations are supporting checks, not a replacement for proof. No independent audit.
limitations: Nonequivariant homotopy classification only; no canonical cycle basis, automorphism representation, or simplicial-collapse claim.
The all-field homology ranks are due to Cioaba and Mim; their numerical result is not claimed as new.
The six triangle faces already appear as a homological two-chain in their Proposition 3.3; the added assertion is their geometric disk structure and its fundamental-group consequence.
An unindexed or implicit equivalent topological proof may exist.
title: Homotopy classification of all Latin-square graph clique complexes
